g.text: When is it safe to just take the lowest premium?

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: 2,274 held-out person-menu cases (758 MEPS adults × 3 real 2027 menus). The lowest premium cost more than $250 extra in 11% of them.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Flaggers were trained on other people; lines are 95% household-bootstrap intervals.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Finding the costly cases (lazy regret over $250)

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: What each way of choosing costs people

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Taking the lowest premium cost more than $250 extra in 11% of person-menu cases. A TabPFN classifier trained on other people spotted them with AUC 0.76 (95% CI 0.73-0.79); flagging its top 20% and giving them

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: TabPFN's expected-cost pick gave mean regret $119 against $106 for always taking the lowest premium (paired difference $+13, 95% CI +6 to +20). With perfect flags the same policy would reach $97.
